subject: Media Literacy
title: Blogs and Citizen Journalism
description: A quick win: understand Blogs and Citizen Journalism.

hook.text: In 2004, bloggers exposed forged documents CBS News used in a story about George W. Bush.

buildup.text: Blogs gave ordinary people the power to publish, fact-check, and challenge mainstream media.

discovery.text: Citizen journalism meant eyewitnesses could report events before professional reporters arrived.

twist.text: But without editors or standards, blogs also became sources of rumor and misinformation.

climax.text: Blogs democratized media — and proved that democracy without oversight can be messy.

punchline.text: Everyone got a press pass. Nobody got an editor.

quiz.question: What was a key drawback of citizen journalism?
options: It lacked editorial oversight and could spread misinformation
